title: Analysis of RCLUPPr: stability, robustness and acceleration
summary: In this work, we present a comprehensive rounding error analysis for RCLUPPr, a recently developed randomized CholeskyQR-type algorithm introduced in \cite{RCLUPP}. This method performs LU factorization with partial pivoting (LUPP faztorization) directly on a full-rank tall-skinny matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$. Unlike RCLUPP in \cite{RCLUPP}, which applies matrix sketching prior to LUPP factorization, RCLUPPr deploys LUPP as an initial preconditioning step to significantly mitigate the propagation of error significantly.
